proof_summary: Take \(n=33085221781504=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where both odd factors are prime. Writing \(b(n)=\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma_1(d)\), the identity \(a(n)=2\sigma_1(n)-b(n)\) and multiplicativity give \(a(n)=2\cdot32767\cdot4410\cdot458010-65519\cdot4411\cdot458011=1\), while this \(n\) is neither \(1\) nor \(12\).
